validation.logical_name: lowercase ASCII slash-separated logical namespace; no empty, dot, dotdot, backslash, drive, Unicode, control, leading, or trailing slash segment
validation.content_base64: RFC 4648 standard alphabet A-Z a-z 0-9 + / with exact canonical padding and encode(decode(value)) === value
validation.decoded_byte_length: canonical non-negative safe integer token 0 or [1-9][0-9]*

precedence: Raw document checks: DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE, then BOM_NOT_ALLOWED, then INVALID_UTF8.
Strict JSON traversal reports the first parser failure among malformed syntax, duplicate keys, invalid Unicode, depth, unsafe integers, and non-canonical integers.
Root validation: object shape, unknown fields, missing fields, profile support, artifacts array type, then artifact count.

Artifacts validate in input order. Each validates object shape, unknown fields, missing fields, field types, ID byte limit and grammar, logical-name byte limit and grammar, Base64 encoded/decoded limits and canonicality, declared length, then SHA syntax.

After all artifacts are individually valid: duplicate artifact IDs, duplicate logical names, declared total decoded-byte limit, decoded-length mismatches in input order, then SHA-256 mismatches in input order.
Only a fully accepted bundle is projected and sorted by ASCII (logical_name, artifact_id). Rejected inputs never return partial metadata.
nonclaims: No filesystem access, opening, path containment, symlink handling, or materialization safety.
No transport, envelope binding, receipt, delivery, acknowledgment, retry, routing, or transfer completion.
No persistence, replay cache, idempotency, lifecycle mutation, authority, quorum, policy, or execution.
No identity, signature, authentication, authorization, trust, provenance, malware scanning, sandboxing, or content-semantic validation.
A matching digest proves only consistency between caller-supplied bytes and caller-supplied metadata.
No interoperability or named-client participation claim.

logical_name_grammar.semantics: A lowercase slash-separated logical namespace, not a filesystem path.

frozen_corpus: ASCII ordering and paired input permutations
JSON depth 16 accepted by parser and depth 17 rejected
safe integer 2^53-1 accepted by parser and 2^53 rejected
declared total decoded-byte limit precedes later digest mismatch
boundary_evidence.rationale: Multi-megabyte frozen JSON fixtures would duplicate deterministic generated witnesses and materially inflate this black-box package; the acceptance record must name the exact harness commands and counts.

precedence_authority: The precedence array is the sole normative validation ordering for v0.1.
